format:
<template>
  <v-card class="pa-4">
    <v-card-title>Range Slider</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text>
      <v-range-slider
        v-model="sliderRange"
        :min="min"
        :max="max"
        :step="step"
        label="Select Range"
        thumb-label="always"
        @update:model-value="onRangeChange"
      ></v-range-slider>
    </v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  // Use the built-in Vue component structure for the ui-template
  data() {
    return {
      // The range value is an array of [min, max]
      // Initialize with default values
      sliderRange: [20, 60],
      // Define properties for min, max, and step
      min: 0,
      max: 100,
      step: 1
    };
  },
  methods: {
    // This method is called whenever the slider value changes
    onRangeChange(newRange) {
      // Send the new range array back to the Node-RED flow
      // The payload will be: { payload: [min_value, max_value] }
      this.send({ payload: newRange });
    }
  },
  watch: {
    // Watch for incoming messages on 'msg' and update the slider value
    msg(newMsg) {
      // Check if the incoming message has a payload that is an array of two numbers
      if (Array.isArray(newMsg.payload) && newMsg.payload.length === 2) {
        // Update the reactive data property
        this.sliderRange = newMsg.payload;
      }
      
      // Optionally, you can also allow setting min/max/step dynamically:
      if (newMsg.min !== undefined) {
        this.min = newMsg.min;
      }
      if (newMsg.max !== undefined) {
        this.max = newMsg.max;
      }
      if (newMsg.step !== undefined) {
        this.step = newMsg.step;
      }
    }
  },
  // Lifecycle hook for initial setup if needed
  mounted() {
    // Send an initial message on component load (optional)
    this.send({ payload: this.sliderRange, topic: "initial_load" });
  }
};
</script>
